requirements.title: Table 5.1 statement-order boundaries are mandatory
requirements.source: 5.3.2 Table 5.1 and p1, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF57-58.
requirements.definition: The illustrated vertical groups may be interspersed only within a group, and horizontal boundaries shall not be interspersed; nonexecutable statements generally precede executable statements between USE and CONTAINS.

pending.use-before-import-implicit-and-declarati: Compile PROGRAM p with USE iso_fortran_env, ONLY: int32 before IMPLICIT NONE and integer(int32) :: x; assign x=89 and check x.
pending.declarations-before-ordinary-executables: Compile PROGRAM p with integer :: x before x=90 and exact check x==90.
pending.no-late-declaration-after-executable: Diagnostic source moves integer :: y after x=90; repair moves only that declaration before x=90.

requirements.title: Internal and module subprograms follow CONTAINS
requirements.definition: Internal or module subprograms shall follow a CONTAINS statement.

pending.internal-subprogram-after-contains: Compile PROGRAM p with CONTAINS followed by internal SUBROUTINE s assigning x=91; main calls s and checks x.
pending.module-subprogram-after-contains: Compile MODULE m with CONTAINS followed by function f() returning 92; main USEs m and checks f()==92.
pending.missing-contains-before-subprogram-rejec: Diagnostic source places SUBROUTINE s directly in PROGRAM p without CONTAINS; repair adds only CONTAINS before the subroutine.

requirements.title: ENTRY, FORMAT, and DATA may appear among executable statements
requirements.definition: Between USE and CONTAINS in a subprogram, ENTRY, FORMAT, and DATA statements may appear among executable statements.

requirements.definition: Table 5.2 shows which statement types are allowed in main, module, submodule, block data, external, module, internal, and interface-body scoping units.
